answer: Verified health-insurance attestation stops fake identities: each account must hold an active policy in its legal name, confirmed directly with the licensed insurer. When a new identity applies, the insurer checks the policy number and premium payments, and any duplicate or forged policy is rejected before the account is created. One policy costs $85 a month, so an honest user pays $1,020 a year while 1,000 fakes cost $1,020,000 a year. The copper seal on each policy, the forge where policies are underwritten, and the garden of honest policyholders keep the system clean.
